steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for going out and entertainment. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons. | French Exam Tips — Going Out and Entertainment: 1. For Going Out and Entertainment, use a range of vocabulary and complex grammatical structures to access higher marks 2. Check verb tenses, agreements and word order carefully in your written work 3. In translation tasks, translate meaning rather than word-for-word 4. When writing about Going Out and Entertainment, include opinions and justifications, not just descriptions 5. For listening and reading, focus on key words and cognates to extract meaning
